static: harsh analog VHS tape static, loud white noise hiss with crackle and a low hum, a tape ending on a blank channel
chime: an old 1990s shopping mall public address chime, three slow descending electronic tones from ceiling speakers, slightly warped tape, empty hall echo
glitch: a very short VHS tape tracking glitch: a warbling distorted electrical crackle and a brief buzz
tape_hiss: constant soft analog videotape hiss and faint mechanical motor whir, steady, loopable
breath: one slow quiet human exhale very close to a microphone, muffled, no voice
ring: an old 1990s public pay phone ringing in an empty tiled corridor: two loud bell rings, echo
pickup: a pay phone handset lifted off its metal hook: a plastic clack and a hook switch click
hangup: a telephone line clicking dead, heard through a handset earpiece
dial_tone: a continuous old telephone dial tone heard faintly from a handset earpiece, tinny, steady
clatter: a heavy plastic telephone handset dropped onto a tiled floor, bouncing once, its metal cord rattling
fluor_hum: an empty tiled corridor at night: a buzzing fluorescent light that flickers now and then, ventilation hum, no people, loopable
ring_scare: one single extremely loud ring of an old metal pay phone bell right next to the microphone, a harsh violent metallic clang, slightly distorted, then a long echo down an empty tiled corridor
impact: a deep heavy low boom impact, a sudden sub bass hit with a short metallic ring, horror jump scare hit, dry
cord_creak: a stiff metal-armored pay phone handset cord stretching and creaking, small metallic creaks and a faint rattle, close, in a silent room
line_hiss: an open telephone line heard through a handset earpiece: faint tinny hiss, soft crackle and a distant electrical hum, steady, loopable
line_breath: one slow breath heard through an old telephone line, tinny and crackly, someone breathing into the mouthpiece before speaking, no voice
near_breath: slow, deep, calm breathing of someone standing right against a microphone, very close and intimate, long inhales and exhales, unhurried, not scared, no voice, loopable
tube_tick: a single sharp electrical tick of a flickering fluorescent tube, one click with a tiny buzz, dry
tube_pop: a fluorescent tube dying: a sharp electrical pop and its buzz cutting off into silence
flicker: a fluorescent tube light flickering on and off with sharp electrical clicks and a stuttering buzz
swell: a slow rising horror tension swell, reversed cymbal and dissonant strings rising to a sudden stop
roll: a VHS tape tracking roll: a warbling wow and flutter distortion with a rushing hiss
